resource: entries in one ACTOR_COOLDOWNS snapshot or delta (state domain 20)
allocation_impact: At most one entry per {kind, id}; a repeated key fails closed. The codec ceiling is the FND-02 repeated-field limit; the producer bound is SPELL-RL-04 (spells in one content-generation spell book) plus 16 group slots, set when composition measures SPELL-RL-04. The decoder refuses a 4,097th entry LimitExceeded before storing it.
boundary_tests: max=4096: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/presentation_tests.rs cooldowns_round_trip_within_their_bounds (4,096 distinct entries encode and decode)
max+1=4097: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/presentation_tests.rs cooldowns_round_trip_within_their_bounds (a 4,097th entry is refused LimitExceeded in both directions)
notes: SPELL-PRESENT-0 §10 and §13 (SPELL-RL-04 + 16). SPELL-RL-04 is still unregistered (SPELL-D6 leaves it to composition), so the effective value is configured within this range by SPELL-PRESENT-1 and never above 4,096. Registered by PRESENT-WIRE-1 (MAGIC-CAST-1, #1622).
